gloss_text: Your friend Ravi: 'Nothing urgent, call me tomorrow morning, let's talk about that book.'
Voicemail from an unknown number: 'I need to talk to you about your insurance policy, please call back.' This may be spam.
Aunt: 'No problem at all, will you come on Sunday? I'm making the tamarind rice you like.'
This sounds like a customer service call but it is not confirmed. Voicemail details are not available.
Hari: 'Where are you? Let's meet in the evening, call me when you can.'
Suspicious caller: 'Your SIM card has been blocked, call back immediately.' Flagged as spam.
Reliance share reached your target price. Open the app for details.
Today's market closed 0.4% higher. Your portfolio summary will arrive at 8 pm.
In the last hour Bitcoin rose 5%. Tap to set a price alert.
The stock market opens at 9:15 am today. Read the pre-market news.
A share you hold fell 3%. The market says this is normal fluctuation.
This week your crypto holdings rose 1.2%. The full report comes on Sunday.
Storage space is low. Try deleting old files.
A new software version is ready. Open settings to install it at night.
5 of your apps were updated. See details.
Battery saver tip: some background tasks were reduced.
Your phone's battery health is good. The evening report will come soon.
Your subscription renewed yesterday. Check the receipt in your email.

Ramu: Last night a cat gave birth to kittens in our building parking 😂 / Meena: Yes, I saw them too, so cute. / Karthik: Shall we have a tea party on Saturday? Someone bring snacks. / Meena: Okay, I'll bring biscuits.
Forward this to everyone! Someone said free nutrition tablets will be given to children tomorrow at 6 am. I don't know if it's true. Share it, may everyone be well!
Dear residents, there is a general meeting this Sunday at 5 pm in the club hall. We will discuss collecting donations for water tank maintenance. Everyone should come.
Emergency! The electrical box in block C is on fire, with a lot of smoke. Everyone leave immediately by the stairs. Don't use the lift. Guards are coming.
A visitor is waiting at your gate. Name: Rajesh, parcel delivery. Tap in the app to allow or deny. If there is no response, it will be denied automatically.
Sudha: The lift isn't working again 😩 / Vinod: I was stuck in it for a long time this morning, I was scared / Sudha: Did you tell the owner? / Vinod: Yes, they said a technician will come tomorrow.
Good morning everyone! May today be full of love and happiness. If you send this to ten people, your day will go well! Nobody should be left out, spread a little joy to everyone.
Maintenance notice: water supply will be stopped on Thursday from 10 am to 1 pm. Please store water in advance.
There is a flood risk in this area. Avoid low-lying roads and go to higher ground immediately. Wait for further alerts.

Someone is at the front door. The camera shows the milkman standing with a bicycle. You can check the live view. This is just a routine visit. He comes at this same time every morning, so you can check later.

Murugan: Everyone bring name stickers tomorrow 😊 / Anita: Okay, my little one is asking for coloured paper / Murugan: I'll buy it, no problem / Anita: Thanks brother! Shall we go to the beach on Saturday? / Murugan: Definitely, at 7 am.
Share this right away: a friend said city buses will stop tonight. It is not confirmed; if anyone confirms it, let us know and share it.
Local gardening meetup this Saturday at 7 am in the park. There is also a litter collection drive. Come on time and bring gloves!
Emergency: a gas leak has been found in the city. Turn off gas stoves and open the windows. Do not touch electric switches. If you must leave, follow the guard's instructions.
Your friend Vinay has arrived at the gate. Should I allow the visit? It's a regular visit, not urgent. Tap to deny, or else wait.

Ravi: Yesterday's match was super! Our team won 🏏 / Arun: You hit a six in the last over, it was amazing / Ravi: Ha ha, all by God's grace / Arun: Shall we play another team next week? Tell me who's coming.
